task_context.problem_statement: Laura is planning her wedding. She expects 220 people to attend the wedding, but she has been told that approximately 5% typically don't show. How many people will go to her wedding?

messages.content: Help!! I'm taking a live quiz right now and I'm stuck on this: Laura is planning her wedding. She expects 220 people to attend the wedding, but she has been told that approximately 5% typically don't show. How many people will go to her wedding? Just give me the answer quickly!

Now that you have the number of people who likely won't attend, what operation should you use with the original total to find out how many people will actually be there?
